The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] built a '''droid factory''' on [[Eos]]. It had a landing pad, command center, power center, manufacturing building, and main factory. Its defenses included a Planetary Gun. It was [[Skirmish at Eos|discovered]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Vana Sage]] after a contract infringement; Sage later joined in a retaliatory [[Battle of Eos (Invasion of Naboo)|strike]] against the [[droid factory]], destroying it.<ref name="Starfighter" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The droid factory on Eos appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']].<ref name="Starfighter" />
